repomix.user_provided_header: Phases 9 and 10: Returns Management (RMA), refunds and wallet, procurement, suppliers and supplier users, purchase requests/orders, weighted average cost (WAC), deliveries (ASN), invoices, payments and ledger statements. Includes current uncommitted review fixes, full source, validation, resources, routes, permissions, numbering, authentication, supporting dependencies, database schema, factories and regression tests. Related frontend pages/services are included as they currently exist; many pages are placeholders, not completed UI. All database migrations preserve schema prerequisites. Stock model: damaged is a subset of physical on_hand; available = on_hand - reserved - damaged. Damaged returns add physical on_hand plus damaged movements without increasing saleable stock. WAC updates before stock receipt. Environment secrets and installed dependencies are excluded. Current hardening includes actor-scoped transactional idempotency for PO receipts, supplier payments and ASNs; independent financial permissions; private authenticated attachments; immutable customer wallet ledger and full wallet checkout with cancellation reversal; locked deletes/state changes; whole-unit quantities and limits; approval invalidation; four-decimal net-discount WAC; supplier portal isolation; bounded statements; short-close lifecycle and real multi-process concurrency regressions. Deployment commands and API contract changes are documented in backend/README.md.
